【更新内容】

一、故事

【秘典书库】
● 「广播剧」中新增了广播剧「风雪夜」，将于 9 月 1 日 9:00 后开放。

二、问题修复

【故事】
● 本地化
○ 简体中文
■ 修复了部分文本中的错别字，共 137 处，主要为「必需的证明」误写为「必须的证明」、「蔓延」误写为「漫延」、部分文本存在重复字词等，并同步更新了 16 种语言的对应译文。
○ 繁体中文
■ 修复了繁体中文设置下「圣肉块」的用字，现已统一为「聖肉塊」。
○ 英语
■ 修复了部分文本中混入了其它条目内容的问题。
■ 修复了唤醒体「沙耶」活动造物描述中，附带认知错乱的卡牌数量与作用范围不准确的问题。修复后为：对手牌、抽牌堆和弃牌堆各随机若干张。
○ 韩语
■ 修复了「功能解锁」提示中，所引用的关卡编号错误的问题。修复后为「调查行动」1-8 困难。
■ 修复了「变强途径」说明中，所引用的关卡编号错误的问题。修复后为「调查行动」1-2 普通。
■ 修复了唤醒体「塔薇」的「双翼初张」「四翼渐生」、命轮「伏于夜色」等词缀描述中，部分数值缺失的问题。
■ 修复了唤醒体「蚀灭·萝坦」狂气爆发「断界之剑」的伤害增量，以及「深海怒涛」的临时暴击率被写为固定数字的问题。
○ 日语
■ 修复了「变强途径」说明中，所引用的关卡编号错误的问题。修复后为「调查行动」1-2 普通。
■ 修复了 6 处衍生卡名称错误，「倒计时」更正为「倒数时刻」，以及 1 处「卡牌销毁」更正为「销毁」。
○ 德语
■ 修复了「异常引力」描述中，蓄力与迟缓层数两处数值未显示的问题。
○ 法语
■ 修复了唤醒体「索蕾尔」状态描述中，生效张数未显示、且生效张数描述错误的问题。
○ 西班牙语
■ 修复了「回合结束算力消耗」描述中，层数被误写为固定数字的问题。
○ 葡萄牙语
■ 修复了唤醒体「朵尔」相关描述中，名称文本未正确显示的问题。
○ 印尼语
■ 修复了部分文本中，活动名称显示异常的问题。
○ 泰语
■ 修复了部分描述中，百分号显示错误的问题。
○ 多语言
■ 修复了法语、西班牙语设置下，部分文本错误地显示为「新增」、「变更」的问题，共 147 行，影响约 1,049 处文本。
■ 修复了部分剧情与技能描述中，会错误地显示简体中文文本的问题，共 279 处。涉及德语、英语、西班牙语、法语、印尼语、意大利语、日语、韩语、葡萄牙语、俄语、泰语、土耳其语、越南语。
■ 修复了部分技能、命轮与造物描述中，数值未显示、显示为固定数字或显示位置错误的问题，共 208 处。涉及德语 34 处、西班牙语 28 处、法语 23 处、葡萄牙语 21 处、意大利语 20 处、土耳其语 19 处、日语 14 处、越南语 11 处、泰语 10 处、孟加拉语 10 处、印尼语 9 处、俄语 8 处、繁体中文 1 处。
■ 修复了部分技能与状态描述中，层数等数值错误地显示为文字而非实际数值的问题。涉及德语、西班牙语、法语、葡萄牙语、泰语、越南语。
■ 修复了部分描述中，文字高亮、灰色与震动效果未能正确显示的问题，共 35 处。涉及德语、西班牙语、法语、葡萄牙语、俄语、泰语、越南语、印尼语、日语。
■ 修复了部分含特殊字符的剧情文本翻译缺失的问题。涉及德语 3 条、繁体中文 3 条、土耳其语 2 条、日语 1 条、葡萄牙语 1 条。

【战斗】
● 通用
○ 修复了在部分情况下，打出拥有「折跃」刻印的卡牌并结束超维回合后，「超维空间」上限不正确的问题。
○ 修复了当超维空间已有 5 张以上指令卡时，「折跃」刻印无法触发的问题。
● 唤醒体
○ 修复了唤醒体「希莱斯特」超限爆发获得的「纯白梦境」，回复提高 50％ 的效果未生效的问题。
● 关卡
○ 修复了「调查行动」第二部第 6 章「山宴」共鸣效果生成的「万化之果-公正之羽」的描述不完整的问题。修复后「护盾和生命回复」更正为「最终护盾和生命回复」，与实际效果一致。
○ 修复了敌人「索魂者」、「白雪仙女」、「圣子·白夜」攻击时，我方队伍部分受击特效缺失的问题。
○ 修复了敌人「催眠妖虫」无法被「命运裁断」斩杀的问题。

【综合】
● 修复了在「密契」界面结合已装备的密契后，「强化秘仪」中无法更换唤醒体的问题。

**V2.6.0.3 Online Maintenance Announcement**

Dear Keeper,
The Mythag Administration Office will conduct campus facility maintenance on  August 31, 2026 at 18:55(UTC+8) . You will be notified once the update is complete and you can re-enter the game. As an apology for any inconvenience caused by the update, we will provide a supply package. Wishing everyone a successful investigation!
In this update, items marked with ☆ at the end are based on feedback from Keepers in the community. Thank you all, Keepers, for your patience and support!
   
[Compensation]
Online Maintenance Compensation: Silver×50
   
[Claim Conditions]
The claiming time ends on September 14, 2026 at 23:59. Please remember to go to your mailox in time to claim the supply materials.
   
[Update Content]

1. Story

[Library]
● A new Radio Drama, "Wind and Snow Night," has been added to "Radio Drama" and will be available after 9:00 on September 1st.

2. Bug Fixes

[Story]
● Localization
○ Simplified Chinese
■ Fixed typos in some texts, totaling 137 instances, mainly including "Required Proof" miswritten as "Required Proof", "Spread" miswritten as "Spread", repeated words/phrases in certain texts, etc. The corresponding translations in 16 languages have been updated accordingly.
○ Traditional Chinese
■ Fixed the text for "Holy Flesh Chunk" in the Traditional Chinese settings, now unified as "Holy Flesh Chunk".
○ English
■ Fixed an issue where content from other entries was mixed into certain text.
■ Fixed an issue in the Awakener "Saya" active Relic description where the number of Cards inflicting Perception Warp and their scope were inaccurate. After the fix: Randomly targets a number of Cards each in the Hand, Draw Pile, and Discard Pile.
○ Korean
■ Fixed an issue where the Stage number referenced in the "Feature Unlock" Hint was incorrect. After the fix, it now correctly refers to Investigation 1-8 Hard.
■ Fixed an issue where the Stage number referenced in the "Power-Up Methods" description was incorrect. After the fix, it now reads "Investigation" 1-2 Normal.
■ Fixed an issue where certain values were missing in the Affix descriptions of Awakener "Tawil"'s "Twin Wings", "Four Wings", and Wheel of Destiny "Cloaked in the Night".
■ Fixed an issue where the damage increment of Awakener "Lotan: Cetarchon"'s Exalt "Mundus Severance," as well as the Temporary Crit. Rate of "Raging Waves," were written as fixed numbers.

○ Japanese
■ Fixed an issue where the Stage number referenced in the "Power-Up Methods" description was incorrect. After the fix, it now reads "Investigation" 1-2 Normal.
■ Fixed 6 instances of incorrect Derived Card names, "Countdown" corrected to "Countdown Moment", and 1 instance of "Card Destroy" corrected to "Destroy".
○ German
■ Fixed an issue where two values in the "Anomalous Gravity" description — Charge stacks and Stagnation stacks — were not displaying correctly.
○ French
■ Fixed an issue with the Awakener "Sorel" where the active card count was not displayed and the active card count description was incorrect in the State description.
○ Spanish
■ Fixed an issue where the stack count in the "End of Turn Arithmetica Cost" description was incorrectly written as a fixed number.
○ Portuguese
■ Fixed an issue where the name text for the Awakener "Doll" was not displaying correctly in related descriptions.
○ Indonesian
■ Fixed an issue where event names were displayed incorrectly in certain text.

○ Thai
■ Fixed an issue where the percent sign was displayed incorrectly in certain descriptions.
○ Multilingual
■ Fixed an issue in French and Spanish settings where some text was incorrectly displayed as "New" or "Changed," affecting 147 lines and approximately 1,049 text instances.
■ Fixed an issue where Simplified Chinese text was incorrectly displayed in certain Story and skill descriptions, affecting 279 instances. Languages affected: German, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Thai, Turkish, and Vietnamese.
■ Fixed 208 instances where values were not displaying, displaying as fixed numbers, or displaying in incorrect positions in certain skill, Wheel of Destiny, and Relic descriptions. This includes 34 in German, 28 in Spanish, 23 in French, 21 in Portuguese, 20 in Italian, 19 in Turkish, 14 in Japanese, 11 in Vietnamese, 10 in Thai, 10 in Bengali, 9 in Indonesian, 8 in Russian, and 1 in Traditional Chinese.
■ Fixed an issue where certain skill and State descriptions incorrectly displayed stacks and other values as text instead of actual numbers. Affected languages: German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Thai, and Vietnamese.
■ Fixed an issue in certain descriptions where text highlighting, gray coloring, and shake effects were not displaying correctly, totaling 35 instances. Affected languages include German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, and Japanese.
■ Fixed an issue where Story text translations containing certain special characters were missing. This affected 3 entries in German, 3 in Traditional Chinese, 2 in Turkish, 1 in Japanese, and 1 in Portuguese.

[Combat]
● General
○ Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, playing a Card with the "Warp" Orison and ending the Ultra Round would cause the "Ultra Space" cap to be incorrect.
○ Fixed an issue where the "Warp" Orison could not trigger when Ultra Space already had 5 or more Command Cards.
● Awakener
○ Fixed an issue where the Healing Boost 50% Effect from the "Tintless Dream" gained through Awakener "Celeste"'s Over-Exaltation was not taking effect.
● Stage
○ Fixed an issue where the description of "Fruit of Myriad Changes - Feather of Justice" generated by the resonance Effect of "Investigation" Chapter 6 "When the Mountain Feasts" in Act II was incomplete. After the fix, "Shield and HP Healing" has been corrected to "final Shield and HP Healing," consistent with the actual Effect.
○ Fixed an issue where some Hit effects were missing for our team when enemies "Soul Reaper", "Snow White the Fairy", and "Divus: The White Night" performed ATK.
○ Fixed an issue where the enemy "Hypnotic Shaggai" could not be killed by "Final Verdict".

[General]
● Fixed an issue where, after combining an equipped Covenant in the "Covenant" menu, the Awakener could not be swapped in the Growth Guide.
